name: Progression
body:
## :gem: Congrats, you've found a hidden Web 3 gem! :gem:

[**The main release blogpost can be found here!**](https://blog.akasha.world/2018/04/18/akasha-web-mend-the-gap/)

If you are reading these lines, you are one of the first pioneers about to embark in a new AKASHA experience. The edges of this adventure are filled with things that might behave in unexpected ways and bugs that can jump from nowhere. 

If you encounter any of these, **be a hero** and ✨ [open a GitHub issue!](https://github.com/AkashaProject/dapp/issues/new)✨ 

Help us improve the experience for everyone! ❤️ 

### Instructions

**Windows pioneers** can download `AKASHA.Setup.0.7.2.exe` or `AKASHA-0.7.2-win.zip`

**Mac pioneers** can download `AKASHA-0.7.2.dmg` or `AKASHA-0.7.2-mac.zip`

**Linux pioneers** can download `AKASHA_0.7.2_amd64.deb` or `AKASHA-0.7.2-x86_64.AppImage` or `AKASHA-0.7.2.zip`

**We recommend Linux users to install the dapp via [snapcraft](https://snapcraft.io/akasha)** or by running `snap install --classic akasha` (full permissions) or `snap install akasha` (strict mode). To update an existing snap install, run `snap refresh akasha`.

See you on AKASHA! \o/

### Bug fixes 😅

- Images now loading correctly also on retina displays
- MacOS icon
- Replies fetching
- Various other minor fixes


### Optimizations 🤓 

- [UI/UX] Dashboard sidebar now redesigned as a top-bar popover 
- [UX] You can now confirm a transaction by pressing the `Enter` key
